summary.headline: Apomasar’s Astrological Chapters
summary.text: Astrological chapter list attributed to Apomasar, covering planetary effects in wells, Jupiter’s lordship and exaltation, lunar conjunctions with Saturn and Mars, nativity and conception, kint or kinon, epilepsy, illness, rulers, legitimacy, aphetai and parental life, interrogations, comprehension of thought, and the natural action of stars.
